title: Welsh Rarebit
description: A traditional British dish made with melted cheese sauce served over toasted bread.
instructions: 2. In a saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
3. Add the flour and whisk to make a smooth paste.
4. Gradually add the milk, whisking continuously.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
6. Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted.
7. Add the Welsh rarebit sauce and stir until well combined.
8. Toast the bread until it's lightly browned.
9. Spoon the cheese sauce over the toasted bread.
